definitions.explanation: The foot or leg on the right side of the body. As with {足|あし} in general, this can refer to either the foot only or the whole leg depending on context.

examples.japanese: {右足|みぎあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦けがした→けがする：01632_kegasuru⟧。
{右足|みぎあし}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ボール→ボール：00017_booru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蹴|け}った→蹴る：02054_keru⟧。
examples.english: I kicked the ball with my right foot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{転|ころ}んで→転ぶ：00863_korobu⟧{右足|みぎあし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{足首|あしくび}→足首：00918_ashikubi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{捻挫|ねんざ}→捻挫：05016_nenza⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧しまい、⟦{一週間|いっしゅうかん}→一週間：10979_isshuukan⟧{松葉杖|まつばづえ}⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧になった。
examples.english: I fell and sprained my right ankle, ending up on crutches for a week.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{右|みぎ}→右：02257_migi⟧ (right) + ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧ (foot/leg). Like ⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧, can mean either the foot only or the whole leg.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {右足|みぎあし}でける: to kick with the right foot
- {右足|みぎあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧: to put the right foot forward; to take a step
- {右足|みぎあし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{骨折|こっせつ}→骨折：02763_kossetsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to break one's right leg
- {右足|みぎあし}{首|くび}: right ankle

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{左足|ひだりあし}→左足：27500_hidariashi⟧: left foot/leg — the symmetric counterpart
- {右脚|みぎあし}: written with ⟦{脚|あし}→脚：28733_ashi⟧ to specifically mean the leg (not foot)
- {利|き}き{足|あし}: dominant foot
